Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting from property taxation that is leased by certain nonprofit organizations from other nonprofit organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting from property taxation that is leasedby certain nonprofit organizations from other nonprofit organizations;adding a new section to chapter 84.36 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Real property owned by a nonprofit organization that is leasedto another nonprofit organization is exempt from taxation. (2) To qualify for the exemption under this section: (a) The nonprofit organization that is the tenant must: (i) Be exempt from federal income taxation under 26 U.S.C. Sec.501(c)(3) of the federal internal revenue code, as amended as ofJanuary 1, 2010; (ii) Use the property exclusively for a purpose which qualifies thenonprofit organization for exemption from federal income tax under 26U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3) of the federal internal revenue code, as amendedas of January 1, 2010. Use under this subsection must be actual; and (iii) Occupy the leased property; and p. 1 SB 6307 (b) The nonprofit organization that is the lessor must be exemptfrom federal income taxation under 26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3) of thefederal internal revenue code, as amended as of January 1, 2010.
